title: The price of empire: silver, debts and prices
goal: Read what silver did to Spain, to the world and to the colonies, and use sin embargo, no obstante, aunque and a pesar de que to contrast its benefits and costs.

items: Use *sin embargo*, *no obstante*, *aunque* and *a pesar de que* to contrast the benefits and the costs of silver.
Say what the Spanish crown did with much of the silver.
Say what historians disagree about in the rise of prices.
Say where a very large part of the silver ended up.
Say what happened to the majority of the population in America.
